high_level_description: A single small terrier in a dynamic digging pose, wearing a visible brown leather harness, positioned low on a 1600x900 canvas with pale sky above and grass below.

compositional_deconstruction.background: pale sky fills upper 75% of canvas; grass band occupies bottom 150px

elements.desc: terrier body: compact tan oval centered horizontally, low on canvas
terrier head: small tan circle above body, slightly forward-tilted
left front leg: vertical brown rectangle, angled slightly forward, extending into grass
right front leg: vertical brown rectangle, angled slightly forward, extending into grass
left hind leg: shorter brown rectangle, angled back, embedded in grass
right hind leg: shorter brown rectangle, angled back, embedded in grass
brown leather harness: horizontal strap across chest, with central buckle
grass band: horizontal green rectangle filling bottom 150px of canvas
